title: Repair: Print a fixed line (drop_check)
prompt:
The following Zero program does not compile: a fallible call is invoked without `check`. Fix it so it compiles and runs correctly. Original task: Write a single-file Zero program whose `main` prints exactly `ready` followed by a newline.

```zero
pub fn main(world: World) -> Void raises {
    world.out.write("ready\n")
}
```

Respond with ONLY the corrected Zero source for `main.0`.

title: Repair: Print a fixed line (drop_raises)
prompt:
The following Zero program does not compile: main is no longer marked `raises` but still calls fallible operations with `check`. Fix it so it compiles and runs correctly. Original task: Write a single-file Zero program whose `main` prints exactly `RL ready` followed by a newline.

```zero
pub fn main(world: World) -> Void {
    check world.out.write("RL ready\n")
}
```

Respond with ONLY the corrected Zero source for `main.0`.
